purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-18905 with one node:test case each in test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-214) removes the flags as it makes them pass.
title: US-18905 UX intake gate suite (discovery-gate)

testCases.description: [happy] Given readiness computes, when the stages are listed, then D0 (gate define.discovery, short name discovery) precedes D1 in STAGE_ORDER, its policy is blocking, it is absent from WARN_WITH_ACK, every discovery:* check carries the productOwner persona, and rcf define readiness --check discovery exits 4 when D0 fails and 0 when it passes or is notApplicable.

[happy] Given a declared central product, when D0 evaluates, then it runs discovery:declared, discovery:journeyPresent, discovery:stepsNameScreens, discovery:reachable, discovery:interruptions, discovery:wireframePerStep, discovery:wireframeFormat, discovery:wireframeSelfContained and discovery:reviewed, and given a declared light product the same set runs with discovery:wireframePerStep and discovery:reviewed notApplicable, so a light product is never refused for a missing wireframe or a missing review.

[edge] Given a declared none product or a tree with no journey.json, when D0 evaluates, then it reports notApplicable with the reason "product declared not UI-bearing" or "no discovery declaration (existing tree)", journey.json is the only file under rcf/discovery/ read, and the door check passes without reading any other file.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js::AC-18905-3 edge: a declared none product or a tree with no journe

testCases.description: [failure] Given a declared light or central product whose D0 fails, when rcf define ledger brief add, rcf define create or rcf define blueprint add runs, then it exits 4 before any write, the message begins "[error] refused define:" and names the declared value, the failing check, the failing ids and the readiness check to run, and the tree is byte-identical before and after.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js::AC-18905-4 failure: a declared light or central product whose d0 fai

testCases.description: [happy] Given a central product reviewed at the current hash, or a light product whose journey answers the catalogue whether or not it has been reviewed, when rcf define ledger brief add, rcf define create or rcf define blueprint add runs, then the door check passes and the write lands as it did before this requirement.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js::AC-18905-5 happy: a central product reviewed at the current hash o

testCases.description: [must-not] Given D0 failing, when rcf define readiness --ack discovery or rcf define freeze runs, then no acknowledgement path exists for D0: --ack discovery exits 2 as not ackable and freeze refuses through its failing block naming D0.

[must-not] Given a product whose D0 fails, when rcf define update, delete, link, unlink, design, standards, the decisions, concerns or probes ledgers, readiness or questions run, then they are not gated and complete as they did before this requirement.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js::AC-18905-7 must-not: a product whose d0 fails

testCases.description: [happy] Given rcf define questions --persona productOwner on a failing D0, when it runs, then the D0 items come first, each with a plain question template and a write-back naming the journey verb that resolves it, and a none product or a grandfathered tree contributes no D0 question.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js::AC-18905-8 happy: rcf define questions persona productowner on a f

testCases.description: [failure] Given a record whose JourneyRecord.ui is null (the record rcf init writes), when D0 evaluates, then discovery:declared fails with a why naming the declare verb and the three values, D0 is failing, and the door check refuses as it does for any failing D0 until a declaration is made.
testCases.testPointer: test/discovery/discovery-gate.test.js::AC-18905-9 failure: a record whose journeyrecordui is null the recor
